items.en: Oyaki filled with Pickled Nozawana Greens
items.note: NOT GLUTEN-FREE — Irohado's dough is wheat flour blended with buckwheat flour, in every single product; their own allergen line reads 小麦、そば、大豆. Vegan: shop's FAQ states no egg and no dairy, fried in soybean oil, and the filling is nozawana pickle + Shinshu miso. Miso type (rice vs barley) is not disclosed.

items.en: Oyaki filled with Spring Onion & Miso
items.note: NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough, and the filling itself adds パン粉 (wheat panko) on top of that: 長葱、小麦粉、味噌、大豆油、砂糖、パン粉、そば粉、酵母、食塩. The single worst item here for a celiac. Plant ingredients only, so vegan.
NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough. One of only two fillings with no miso in it (原材料: かぼちゃ、小麦粉、砂糖、大豆油、そば粉、食塩、酵母), so it is the simplest for a vegan, but the wheat is unavoidable.
NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough. Cabbage, nozawana pickle, onion and carrot with Shinshu miso. All plant ingredients.

items.en: Oyaki filled with Dried Shredded Daikon
items.note: NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough. Dried daikon, spring onion, carrot and Shinshu miso. All plant ingredients.
NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough. Domestic shimeji, spring onion and Shinshu miso. All plant ingredients.

items.en: Oyaki filled with Chunky Sweet Red Bean Paste
items.note: NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough. The sweet one; no miso, no soy sauce (小豆餡、小麦粉、砂糖、大豆油、そば粉、酵母、食塩). Vegan.

items.section: 単品おやき (Single Oyaki) · 季節限定
items.note: NOT GLUTEN-FREE — wheat + buckwheat dough. Summer only: diced round eggplant dressed in Shinshu miso. All plant ingredients.

items.en: Oyaki filled with Spicy Eggplant (summer seasonal)
items.section: 単品おやき (Single Oyaki) · 季節限定
items.note: NOT GLUTEN-FREE, twice over — wheat + buckwheat dough, plus the moromi-nanban seasoning from a Zenkoji-front miso brewery lists 醤油 (ordinary wheat soy sauce, not tamari) in its own ingredient breakdown: もろみ（米麹、醤油、青唐辛子）. Vegan.

NOT GLUTEN-FREE. Online-shop set price; the MIDORI Nagano counter may price differently. All Irohado oyaki are egg-free and dairy-free per the shop's FAQ, so any set is vegan — but none is ever wheat-free.
NOT GLUTEN-FREE. Larger multiples exist at proportional prices (14 pc ¥4,060 / 21 pc ¥6,090 / 28 pc ¥8,120 / 35 pc ¥10,150). Online-shop prices.

items.ja: 七味唐辛子 いろは堂ブレンド
items.en: Shichimi Chilli Blend — Irohado house blend
items.note: House seven-spice blend sold as a product, not a dish. Shichimi is normally chilli, sansho, sesame, nori, hemp, poppy and citrus peel — no wheat by design — but Irohado does not publish this blend's ingredient list, and the shop notes sesame runs on the same production line. Ask.

items.ja: バーガー for ビーガン
items.note: The pub's own listed vegan dish, built on a tofu patty made from Kawanakajima 'Kamaokose' tofu. NOT gluten-free: the buns come from Ooka Cafe Terrace Momo and are wheat. Vegan capability is confirmed by the city's local-produce council listing and by Shokutabi Nagano, which adds 「ビーガン対応可（事前申告）」 — vegan service works best with advance notice. Price not published.

Tofu from Kawanakajima Kamaokose made with Nagano-grown 'Hitorimusume' soybeans. The tofu itself is plant-based and wheat-free, but hiyayakko is served poured with soy sauce and usually topped with katsuobushi — both of which would break it. Ask for it plain, or with the house tofu dip instead.

items.en: Tofu Collaboration Plate (chilled tofu, okara karinto, atsuage)
items.note: Three preparations of the same local tofu: hiyayakko, okara karinto and atsuage (deep-fried tofu). Karinto is normally a wheat-flour fried sweet, so this plate is very unlikely to be wheat-free — and the atsuage frying oil is shared. Ask about each of the three separately.

items.ja: 有機野菜 彩（いろどり）
items.note: Seasonal organic vegetables from Shinshu Matsushiro Miyazaki Farm. IMPORTANT for vegans: it is served with dips, and the reported ones differ — a miso dip (Inoue Jozo miso) and a tofu dip per the shop's own copy, but bagna cauda per a launch write-up, and bagna cauda is anchovy and dairy. Also seen listed at ¥1,000+ as 信州野菜. Specify the tofu dip and ask what the sauce of the day is.

Pickled in Nanaiai-grown sorghum vinegar from Farm Uchikawa — a grain vinegar, but sorghum rather than wheat or barley, which is unusually good news here. Plant-based. Still ask, because the pickling liquid's other seasonings are not published.

Made from vegetables grown by the owner's mother. Japanese potato salad is bound with egg mayonnaise and commonly includes ham — assume egg. Mayonnaise itself is normally wheat-free but ask about the vinegar and any added seasoning.

Made by Shinshu Nagano Jozo. Soy sauce is the dish — standard Japanese shoyu is brewed with wheat and no tamari is claimed, so treat as containing gluten. Plant-based unless dashi was added; ask if that matters to you.

Rice is naturally gluten-free, but this one is glazed with Inoue Jozo miso and the miso type is not disclosed anywhere — Shinshu miso is by category a rice miso, but this brewery's product is unstated, and grilled onigiri glazes often mix in soy sauce. Ask for it plain if you need it safe. Miso can also be dashi-fortified.

Local black soybeans seasoned with salt only, per the tasting report. Salt-only seasoning is the reason this one is safe where the miso and soy-sauce dishes are not — but confirm nothing else was added.
Boiled and salted green soybeans — no wheat, no animal products. Alongside the salted black soybeans, the most reliable thing on this menu for a restricted diet.
Wheat bun plus a panko-crumbed deep-fried minced-meat patty — wheat in two places, and the shared fryer as well. Beef/pork.
Wheat bread, panko-crumbed cutlet, and tonkatsu sauce (which is itself wheat-thickened). Meat.

items.ja: ソーセージ盛り合わせ
items.note: Pork. Sausage fillers and casings frequently include wheat starch or rusk — ask the maker. Not vegan or vegetarian.

items.ja: チープレ（チーズプレート）
items.note: Dairy cheese with jam from Yama no Jamuya. Vegetarian but not vegan. Cheese and jam are wheat-free, but cheese plates are usually served with crackers or bread — ask them to leave those off.

items.ja: 信州珍味の盛り合わせ
items.en: Shinshu Insect Delicacies Platter (locust, bee larvae, silkworm pupae)
items.note: Nagano's traditional insect foods — inago (locust), hachinoko (bee larvae) and sanagi (silkworm pupae). Inago is classically simmered in soy sauce and sugar, so assume wheat. Animal products by definition.

Made with Nagano-grown sorghum, which is a gluten-free grain — but arare is a savoury cracker and is nearly always seasoned with soy sauce. The grain is the safe part; the seasoning is not documented. Ask.

items.ja: 山の間ライスヴァイツェン
items.note: 'Rice' in the name does not make it gluten-free — a Weizen is brewed from malted WHEAT and barley, with rice as an adjunct. Every beer brewed on these premises contains gluten and the pub offers no gluten-free beer. Beer is usually vegan but finings can be animal-derived.
Malted barley — contains gluten. Part of the hop-forward 唐破風 (Karahafu) house range alongside まごころIPA, 夏の日IPA and 冬の日IPA, all 6%.
Smoked malt — barley, contains gluten. Roughly the house floor price; the pub is generally described as ¥830 and up per glass.
From the clean-and-crisp マウントヘブン (Mount Heaven) house range, along with 太陽がいっぱい ファームハウスセゾン 5%, ピーチウィートエール 5.5% and サンライズセゾン. All malted grain — contains gluten.

items.ja: 二線路ライペールエール
items.note: Named for the street the pub stands on. RYE plus barley malt — rye is itself a gluten grain, so this is doubly out. Around eight taps run at a time, including guest beers from Nuttari Brewery.

items.en: Peach Weizen (made with Kawanakajima white peaches, Sep–Dec)
items.section: クラフトビール (Craft Beer) · 季節限定
items.note: Seasonal September to December, brewed with Kawanakajima hakuto peaches grown in Nagano City. Weizen = malted wheat; contains gluten.
